data.turoyo: Komər hawxa səmme, xd u amro di ḥoṯaṯṯe i naʕəmto, w maṣərre ḥaṣayye. <...> w mḥela b qamaytayye w mčarčaffe ruḥayye w hedi hedi bu šəkəl dap pirat ṭʕine w azzehən lu bayto du šulṭono.
data.translation: Sie taten, wie ihre jüngste Schwester sie geheißen, und gürteten sich die Hüften fest. <...> Die jüngste setzte sich an ihre Spitze, sie warfen ihren Straßenumhang über und wanderten nach Art der schwangeren Frauen langsam, langsam nach dem Hause des Sultans.

summary: Both occurrences checked. mčarčafla ruḥa and mčarčaffe ruḥayye are active reflexive constructions: the wearer is the l-series agent and ruḥo is the object. No Detransitive form or new sense is established.
105/39 supplies plural agreement beside the existing singular feminine 105/17. Imitated pregnancy belongs to the narrative context, not to this verb's meaning.
The entry's I filing and Kurdish etymology are retained. A four-consonant shape alone is not evidence for relabeling the editors' stem.
Does the denominal verb require ruḥo or also allow an expressed garment object? Both supplied tokens are reflexive, so the distribution cannot be determined from this sample.
